subject: cult-info-b
title: (R)CULT.INFO.B.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in The Midwest (and West Coast) Continuum section (MID-W-3), the first of two on book p409. (R)CULT-INFO-B (the reality of culture information basis) is crossed with AFL-DY (affinity dynamics, marked with the (dt) prefix — Braxton's CODE for 'determines the ____ of its ____', meaning affinity dynamics here is functioning as a *determining* relation rather than a relational one). The diagram poses what real culture-information-basis crossed with the determining role of affinity dynamics looks like for a midwest creative community whose 'physical universe situation' (per the section's prose) gives more time for actual research than New York's market-driven environment. CULT-INFO-B → (DT)AFL-DY (the crossing) → MT-INFO (music information) → PART (participation). (R)TM (real terminology) → AFL-DY and (R)TM → INFO-DS (information dissemination) → C-INFO (composite information) → POL-DYM (political dynamics) → (R)INT (real intention). PROG-SIGN (progressional significance) → AFL-DY. AFL-DY → INFO-RT (information reality) *dashed*. Structural argument: the determining-role of affinity dynamics is over-fed by *four* upstreams (the subject, real terminology, progressional significance, and indirectly via the information-dissemination chain), and produces music information and (conditionally) information reality. The midwest's structural advantage Braxton names — more research time, less market pressure — registers diagrammatically as the determining function of affinity dynamics actually being able to do its work, rather than being short-circuited by political dynamics' direct demands.
